objects: Eq. (4.16) projected full-theory fakeon tensor power spectrum

gates.algebra_identity: symbolically verify the leading ratio from the two published normalized tensor spectra
gates.decoupling_scaling: verify ratio grows as xi^-2 at fixed alpha_k and has no finite xi->0 limit
gates.independent_grid: evaluate the ratio on a frozen alpha,xi grid and verify monotone xi^-2 scaling
gates.source_scope: guard that the result concerns quadratic inflation and does not terminalize fakeon gravity or the parent family

notes: A branch-level physical-observable discontinuity is not a family result. The source itself contrasts this quadratic-inflation behavior with the regular Starobinsky case.
